metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Sachin Gulati.

plugins.name: sline
plugins.description: Claude Code status line showing 5-hour and weekly rate limits for all your Claude accounts at once: live for this session, recently checked for the rest. Pace-aware usage, and one command to show or hide the numbers. Reads no credentials.

plugins.name: nk
plugins.description: A knowledge base built out of your work rather than beside it. What outlives the task is promoted into project, workspace or global knowledge, and the same checkpoint makes the session disposable: save, clear, load.
